description: This file defines the LegacyRemoveMemberService class, which manages permission checks and validation for removing members from teams within an organization, including role validation and ownership restrictions.

classes.name: LegacyRemoveMemberService
classes.description: A service class for removing team members with permission validation, ownership checks, and role management.

methods.name: validateTeamsBelongToOrganization
methods.description: Checks if all provided team IDs belong to the specified organization.

methods.name: checkRemovePermissions
methods.description: Determines if a user has permission to remove members based on roles and organization membership.

methods.name: validateRemoval
methods.description: Validates if the removal action is permitted, including ownership and self-removal restrictions.
